evals.prompt:
Draft a commit message for my changes. Here is the output from git-diff.sh:

<<<SECTION:STATUS>>>
 M lib/auth/signup.dart
<<<END:STATUS>>>

<<<SECTION:DIFF_STAT_STAGED>>>
 lib/auth/signup.dart | 15 +++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 15 insertions(+)
<<<END:DIFF_STAT_STAGED>>>

<<<SECTION:DIFF_STAGED>>>
diff --git a/lib/auth/signup.dart b/lib/auth/signup.dart
index 1234567..890abcd 100644
--- a/lib/auth/signup.dart
+++ b/lib/auth/signup.dart
@@ -10,6 +10,21 @@ class SignupPage {
+  bool _validateEmail(String email) {
+    return RegExp(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9+_.-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\$").hasMatch(email);
+  }
<<<END:DIFF_STAGED>>>
evals.expected_output: A conventional commit message of type 'feat', with a scope like 'auth' or 'signup', and a summary about adding email validation.
expectations: The message follows the format 'type(scope): summary'
The summary is in imperative mood (e.g., 'add', 'implement')
The first line is 72 characters or less
The output contains only the commit message text
